blocker: 3/8 held-out causal escapes against a threshold of 6
root_cause_diagnosed: 10 of 11 failures are 'tissue did not fill every role' - the tissue could not form AT ALL, rather than forming a non-escaping shape. The defect is mine: local_inhibition pre-loads Tri.INHIBIT on the cell's ROLE, and INHIBIT dominates ACTIVATE by design, so those cells can never differentiate - not even into a form that WOULD escape. The inhibition blocks the role when it should block only the MOTIF.
why_not_fixed_in_this_pass: The defect was found BY inspecting held-out results. Fixing and re-scoring on the same fixtures would be tuning against held-out data. The fix requires motif-conditional inhibition ('refuse this role in THIS configuration') plus a fresh untouched evaluation set. Recorded as the next assignment rather than quietly applied.
what_the_mechanism_DID_prove: Rejection certificates carry at most 3 information bits while the graph has 3 nodes and 2 edges - the motif cannot reconstruct the predecessor.
Every escape that did occur used dual_read - the tissue found redundant verification locally, without being told to.
